photo_selection.selection_notes: If 0 acceptable photos in intake, skip the Reel for May and refund the slot to June. Do NOT submit a placeholder image — burns the FAL.AI $0.50 with no usable output.

fal_job_spec.prompt: Steam rising slowly from the dish. Subtle oil shimmer on the surface. Hands of the chef placing a final garnish, then stepping out of frame. Camera holds still. Natural daylight. No zoom.
fal_job_spec.negative_prompt: extra fingers, distorted hands, melting, AI artifacts, fast zoom, color shift, neon, sparkles, glitter, glow, blur, fish-eye, rotating, extra plates, extra dishes, morphing, magical effects, fake bokeh, warping, oversaturation, motion blur on subject

captions_and_overlay.ig_caption: AAPI feature · week 3. [DISH NAME] coming together in the kitchen. On the hall this weekend only. 1602 Village Market Blvd SE
captions_and_overlay.music_mood: warm-acoustic-no-bass-drop — operator picks from IG's licensed library at upload time

cost_tracking.operator_approval_required_for: 10s tier (~$1.00) — skip unless festival peak week

failure_path: If Kling output has visible artifacts on 2 consecutive submissions: pick a different source photo, re-submit once more, then skip for the month if still bad. Do not paper over with creative editing.
